author: ojiudezue
title: v5.92.2 shipped: forecast_accuracy unmasked (split display metric; energy control path byte-identical)
summary: forecast_accuracy unmasked (split display metric; energy control path byte-identical)
why: forecast_accuracy read 'unknown' whenever rolling accuracy hit <=0, conflating no-data with a genuinely inaccurate forecaster and hiding a real operator signal; plan-review caught that the naive denominator fix would have altered the DP house-load control loop (pct_error feeds adjustment_factor), so Rev 2 SPLITS the metric — pct_error byte-identical (control untouched), a new bounded SMAPE consumed only by the sensor — keeping this a true display fix while surfacing learning/active/poor/stale states that never share a (value,status) signature.
implications: Shipped FORECAST-ACCURACY-UNKNOWN-MASK-1 at v5.92.2; card(s) sit shipped_organic pending validation. Acceptance in README_v5.92.2.md (Live criteria).
revisit_trigger: sensor.ura_energy_coordinator_forecast_accuracy renders a numeric value with a status attribute (learning/active/poor/stale), NOT bare unknown, and exposes eval_age_days; DP house_load_kw / adjustment_factor show no measurable shift post-restart.

refs.release_notes: The forecast_accuracy sensor now surfaces a real numeric value with a status attribute (learning/active/poor/stale) instead of masking rolling accuracy <=0 as 'unknown'. Split-metric fix: pct_error stays byte-identical so the DP house-load control path (adjustment_factor) is untouched; a new sensor-only bounded SMAPE metric drives rolling_accuracy + the three discriminated states + a stale overlay (eval_age_days). 14 tests, two RED drills (native_value neuter, ladder reorder), validator full-suite name-diff clean.
